profilingPlan: Enumerate every delivered cycle CSV and supporting trial/label file from the authoritative manifest; do not infer cycle count from numeric filenames.
Verify publisher MD5 values and compute SHA-256 fingerprints without committing raw files.
Profile one schema family at a time and determine whether all cycle CSVs share headers, units, row counts and time bases.
Identify direct sensor measurements separately from stage labels, setpoints, commands, identifiers and derived fields.
Reconcile cycle files against the all-stages and IRES-label tables without inventing missing cycles or labels.
Count measured time-series values only from delivered direct-measurement columns with established ordering/time semantics.
Emit aggregate schemas, cycle counts and fingerprints only; never upload raw third-party rows or arrays as workflow artifacts.
evidenceBoundary: The CC BY 4.0 Zenodo release has been fully checksum-profiled. PASCOE publications identify paired Kistler 6188A cavity pressure/contact-temperature sensors and synchronized real-time acquisition, while Kistler specifies their engineering ranges in bar and degrees Celsius. This supports partial acceptance of the two delivered cavity-pressure and two cavity-temperature columns. Hydraulic pressure and screw position retain unresolved export-unit/reference details, Analog Input[1] remains generically named, and trial-stage metadata proves Analog Input[2] changes measurement purpose; those fields remain fail-closed.
